FADE IN:

EXT. DESERT LANDSCAPE - DAY

The sun beats down relentlessly, casting a golden glow over the endless dunes. A lone figure, JESSICA, walks towards the horizon, her feet sinking into the scorching sand. She's dressed in a flowing white robe, her long hair blowing in the wind.

Suddenly, a strange glow appears on the horizon. It grows brighter, illuminating the desert landscape. Jessica shields her eyes, feeling an otherworldly energy emanating from the light.

CUT TO:

INT. ABANDONED LABORATORY - DAY

A group of scientists, led by the enigmatic DR. KAZU, frantically work on a top-secret project. They're surrounded by rows of humming machinery and flickering computer screens.

DR. KAZU
(urgently)
We're running out of time! The experiment is critical!

One of the scientists, a young woman named SARAH, looks up from her console, concern etched on her face.

SARAH
But what about the risks? We can't just-

DR. KAZU
(interrupting)
Silence! We've come too far to turn back now.

The scientists nod in unison, their faces set with determination.

CUT TO:

EXT. DESERT LANDSCAPE - DAY

Jessica stands at the edge of a massive crater, the glow from the laboratory illuminating the surrounding landscape. She raises her hands, and the air around her begins to distort.

Suddenly, a portal opens, revealing a desolate wasteland. A figure emerges from the portal, dressed in tattered clothing and carrying a Pip-Boy.

CUT TO:

INT. ABANDONED LABORATORY - DAY

The scientists watch in awe as the portal opens, revealing a world unlike any they've ever seen. Dr. Kazu steps forward, a look of wonder on his face.

DR. KAZU
(whispering)
It's happening. The timeline has split.

The scientists exchange nervous glances, unsure of what to make of this new reality.

CUT TO:

EXT. DESERT LANDSCAPE - DAY

Jessica stands at the edge of the crater, looking out at the desolate wasteland. She takes a deep breath, feeling the weight of her new reality.

JESSICA
(whispering)
I'm not sure what's happening, but I know I have to find a way to navigate this new world.

The camera pans out, revealing the vast expanse of the wasteland, as the sound of radiation and machinery hums in the distance.

FADE TO BLACK.

Note: The screenplay follows the exact moment when the timelines of the real world and Fallout split, as described in the Fallout universe. The events are fictional and not based on any real-world events or timelines.
